title: Friendly adventure with great surprises
text: Great way to spend my evening -- even without the anticipated sunny golden hour. Yes, the umbrellas were up and down, but the experience was still worth every penny. I was lucky to have a great guide, Lautaro "LT", who introduced our small group to new squares and passages of the Albayzin and Sacromonte. He recommended we take a peek into the Iglesia de San Nicolás and pay to climb the tower, which gave us a view of the Alhambra unobstructed by crowds below who gathered for the evening. title: The Magic of the Alhambra, Albayzín, and Sacromonte at Sunset
text:
The sunset walking tour was spectacular! Our guide Mario was friendly, engaging, personable, and well-versed in the history and culture of Albayzín and Sacromonte. As he took us through their narrow uphill walkways and steps, he expertly brought the area’s rich Moorish history to life and helped us gain an appreciation not only for its complex history but also for its architecture.

We had done an earlier guided tour of the Alhambra complex that morning. The sunset tour guided by Mario offered another heavenly vision of the fortress: seeing the Alhambra awash in the soft glow of the setting su
author: GrandTour34154677344

title: one of the Fablous sunset trip
text: I had a wonderful experience with PlayGranada, especially with the Sunset Tour. The tour guide “LT” was absolutely fabulous, friendly, knowledgeable, and made the whole experience very enjoyable. The views and atmosphere were amazing, and it was definitely one of the highlights of my trip to Granada. The reception team especially Maria was also fantastic. They were very helpful and gave me great recommendations about other services, places to visit, and how to explore more of Granada. They were welcoming, professional, and always happy to help. I highly recommend PlayGranada to anyone visiting
